targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: If the AI gets the answer right most of the time, why are we still nervous?

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The simple version is this: the trail of accountability when an AI-shaped decision helps, harms, approves, denies, or misses something important.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The scary part is not the average result. It is the person, patient, team, or company living inside the exception.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: Lovely. We have automated the decision and preserved the blame. Very efficient, in the bleakest possible sense.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: Think of it like a relay race where the baton is blame; the model, vendor, institution, and human signer all touch it.

targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: The question for tomorrow is not whether liability chain sounds clever. It is who gets caught when it becomes real.
